question: Avohass avocado oil company owner parent brand
markdown:
Avohass
is an independent specialty brand. It was founded in 2012 and is owned and operated by co-founders
Donald Jones
and
Amy Bowman
. It is not a subsidiary of a larger parent food conglomerate.
